```lean
lemma posLog_norm_sum_le {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E]

    log⁺ ‖∑ t ∈ s, f t‖ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ ‖f t‖ := by
  calc log⁺ ‖∑ t ∈ s, f t‖

  _ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ ‖f t‖ :=
    posLog_sum s (‖f ·‖)
```
